title: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is…
description: The Everest Forms plugin for WordPress up to version 3.6.4 contains a Missing Authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users with the everest_forms_create_forms capability to activate any inactive plugin on the server by specifying its slug, potentially escalating their privileges to administrator. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has delegated this capability to a lower-privileged role and that an inactive plugin with a slug-based main file exists on the server.
